name: preamble-cycle-growth-controls
description: Preamble growth control in cyclic graphs (fabro-699f): two mechanisms compose with the existing stage envelope. (1) preamble_stages_latest_only=true on a node collapses repeated completed-node visits to each stage's LAST occurrence before build_preamble (node_outcomes is already id-latest, only the list dedups); render-only. (2) context_consume_keys=a,b on a node removes those keys from the durable Context in after_record, AFTER state.record applied updates and BEFORE edge selection; keys the stage itself re-emitted are spared (fresh outputs are not stale inputs). Placement matters: after_record ordering is state.record -> lifecycle.after_record -> resolve_next_step, so consumption is routing-visible if edges read consumed keys.

name: fabro-tools-empty-string-is-noop-deny-comes-from-tools-allowlist
description: fabro-269d (run 01M2W5SFE33QGXKMHP5BS0068A): node-level fabro_tools="" parses to the SAME empty list as an unset attribute (graph.rs split_key_list drops empty entries), and pebble.rs stage_tools registers the FULL fabro-run catalog whenever the named list is empty and services are provisioned (any node's non-empty opt-in, e.g. the develop planner's fabro_runs_list, turns provisioning on run-wide). So an empty-string fabro_tools attribute is a no-op, not a deny. Effective per-node denial of fabro_run_* tools comes from the tools= allow-list middleware (stage_policy.rs node_admits_tool admits only listed names). Develop graph reviewer/implementer now carry fabro_tools="" as intent documentation with comments naming this; a future engine change could make set-but-empty mean deny.
